anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, smooth arc with a medium-radius curvature transitioning from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Visible as a short, tapered protrusion with a pixel length roughly equivalent to its base width at the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-blue bioluminescent glow across the entire form; distinct high-luminance circular point in the ocular region.
